01 / Project Presentation · In-Situ Retail Color Clarity [O / A]
Collection & Store Concept · Chile

Color clarity at the rack.

Rather than isolating shoppers inside a camera booth or pushing an abstract styling app, Color-Play sits directly beside the clothing rail. It pairs physical fabric drapes under calibrated 5000K CRI 95+ light with an optional 12-inch touch station tied to garments on the rack—where skipping or choosing without a camera is always first-class.

Experience Live Kiosk UI ↓ Explore 360° 3D Rack ↓
01 · Shopper Agency

Optional camera with explicit consent, zero stored profiles, and full continuation using only personal wardrobe preferences.

02 · Rack-Side Context [O]

Among n=9 qualifying shoppers, 8 default to familiar colors and 7 discard garments [O, E1]. Guidance points directly to in-store racks.

03 · Staged Validation [A]

Progresses from a zero-tech portable rack study (Stage 1) to an integrated 12-inch touch bay (Stage 2) once behavioral gates pass.

[A] Immediate Discovery Gate (A1–A2) · Zero Tech Integration

Portable human-assisted comparison beside the rack, before hardware commitment.

Footprint [A]

0.8 m² movable garment rail + physical fabric swatch book + clip-on 5000K CRI 95+ lamp.

Shopper Flow [A]

Voluntary invitation → 90-second physical fabric drape check → 2–3 tops pulled from the rack.

Privacy Rule

Zero camera photos, zero stored profiles, and an immediate neutral-garment fallback.

Validation Gate [A]

Pass Gate A1 if ≥ 4/5 shoppers select or try a suggested garment with median trust ≥ 4/5.

[A] Featured Store Fixture · Physical Drapes + 12" Touch Kiosk

A modular 1.2 m² rack station pairing calibrated 5000K light, physical drapes, and the live Kiosk UI.

Footprint [A]

1.2 m² feature bay + 45° angled 12" touch screen + upper 5000K canopy + 4 physical fabric tabs.

Shopper Flow [A]

Welcome at the rack → optional photo or direct wardrobe interview → coordinated outfit on Hooks 01–06.

Privacy Rule

Ephemeral in-memory session only. One-tap “Finish and clear” erases all choices and photos.

Validation Gate [A]

Gates A2–A5: ≥ 80% specialist agreement, verified shift stock freshness, and viable unit economics.

[A] Future Cross-Category Scope · Apparel Buyer + Makeup Champion

Apparel merchandising owns the initial station; Makeup / Beauty champions cross-category vocabulary.

Placement [A]

Positioned on the boundary aisle connecting Women’s Apparel and the Beauty floor.

Shopper Flow [A]

Complete apparel rack look first → optional contrast takeaway card for the beauty counter.

Scope Guardrail

Apparel remains the primary commercial scope; cosmetic shade matching requires separate validation.

DMU Structure [A]

Apparel Buying acts as proposed economic buyer [A]; Beauty acts as internal advocate [A].
